last.verdict: Revenue missed estimates, so the stock fell despite a strong customer quarter and raised guidance.

reasons.label: Revenue missed estimates
reasons.text: Revenue of $34.31B fell short of the ~$34.77B expected; phone upgrade sales dropped 9%.

reasons.label: Big customer gains priced in
reasons.text: 406,000 new phone customers beat the ~195,000 expected, but shares still slipped.

reasons.label: Raised outlook not enough
reasons.text: Full-year profit-per-share growth guidance rose to 7–7.5%, from 6–7%, yet the stock fell.

story: Shares jumped about 12% in January on a strong customer rebound and a $25B buyback. They rose about 3% in July on a profit beat and raised guidance, despite a revenue miss. Now a third raised outlook failed to lift the stock, as revenue disappointed again.
